js: window.__row = () => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar .tool-button')).map(b => (b.getAttribute('data-ev') || b.getAttribute('data-ctl') || '?') + '@' + Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().x * 10) / 10); window.__marks = () => ({ moved: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar .fm-glide-moved')).map(b => b.getAttribute('data-ev')), inFade: document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar .fm-glide-in').length, ghosts: document.querySelectorAll('.fm-glide-ghost').length }); window.__watch = async (ms) => { const seen = { moved: [], inFade: 0, ghosts: 0 }; const t0 = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - t0 < ms) { const m = window.__marks(); for (const k of m.moved) if (!seen.moved.includes(k)) seen.moved.push(k); seen.inFade = Math.max(seen.inFade, m.inFade); seen.ghosts = Math.max(seen.ghosts, m.ghosts); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 25)); } return seen; }; return true
